name: Kazakh Snowball stemmer on KazQAD train

description: baseline: kazakh.sbl as submitted upstream

asi.hypothesis: baseline measurement

description: strip -ған/-ген/-қан/-кен on a one-syllable consonant-final base when the allomorph matches the voicing (шыққан->шық)

asi.hypothesis: one-syllable verbs' participles (шыққан, өткен, болған) should conflate with their finite past (шықты->шық)
asi.rollback_reason: lo99 -0.00025, val -0.0002; losses from қорған->қор (Great Wall), өткен merging with өт 'bile', болған merging into frequent бол
asi.next_action_hint: maybe combine with a guard on -ған after р (қорған) or combine with converb; consider restricting to voiceless -қан/-кен only if justifiable

description: genitive -ның and ablative -нан also after м (адамның, әлемнен -> адам, әлем)

asi.hypothesis: missing allomorph context: -ның/-нан follow м as well as н/ң
asi.rollback_reason: grammatically correct but effect +0.0007 too small for gate; val -0.0002
asi.next_action_hint: bundle with other allomorph-table fixes as one coherent 'case allomorph' change, or revisit when a larger change is kept

description: drop accusative -ны/-ні after a vowel so V+н+ы reads as н-stem + possessive (ауданы->аудан, баланы->балан)

asi.hypothesis: possessive reading of V+н+ы is 2.5x more frequent by df (ауданы 33k docs -> ауда)
asi.rollback_reason: net -0.0001: questions use accusative of vowel-final proper nouns a lot (Алясканы, Энергияны, Американы ойнайтын); wins on өзені queries offset
asi.next_action_hint: need a guard distinguishing the two readings; maybe keep accusative after stems ending in -ия/-ика? (word-shape, risky). Probably abandon.

description: present -ады/-еді on a one-syllable base ending in V+C or sonorant+т (болады->бол, өтеді->өт), with voicing undo

asi.hypothesis: CVC-ады reading dominates CVCA-ды by df 287k vs 24k; present of 1-syl verbs should join their past
asi.rollback_reason: lo99 -0.0016; losses from жасады->жас ('кім жасады'), өт bile merge; wins mostly the 'қайда өтеді' Olympics cluster
asi.next_action_hint: try combined with the one-syllable -ған change (exp2) as a coherent one-syllable-verb treatment

description: combined one-syllable verb treatment: -ған (exp2) + present -ады (exp5)

asi.hypothesis: consistent one-syllable verb conflation (болады/болған/болды -> бол)
asi.rollback_reason: not additive: train +0.0023 lo99 -0.0014, val -0.0017, news -0.0033
asi.next_action_hint: one-syllable verb conflation is a wash on retrieval; stop pursuing it. Look at nominal side or derivational suffixes instead

description: two_syllables counts у/и between consonants as a nucleus (физикалық->физика, футболшы->футбол)

asi.hypothesis: C+у/и+C is a vowel nucleus; loanwords физика/химия/футбол were under-counted
asi.rollback_reason: few queries touched; французша (13.6k docs boilerplate 'in French') merged into француз hurting French revolution queries
asi.next_action_hint: nucleus idea is linguistically right but retrieval-neutral; could be revisited if combined with excluding -ша (similative/language adverb)

description: temporal adjective -ғы/-гі only after voiced, -қы/-кі only after voiceless consonant (халқы->халық, түркі->түрк, жылқы no longer жыл)

asi.hypothesis: allomorph voicing agreement separates the adjective suffix from root-final к/қ + possessive
asi.lesson: precise allomorph/voicing guards that remove collisions give clean low-variance wins

description: allomorph guards: -дың/-дан not after nasals (and -дың not after strong vowel); instrumental -мен/-бен/-пен by final sound

asi.hypothesis: precise case allomorph contexts remove collisions like түрікмен->түрік
asi.rollback_reason: too few queries affected (1 win/4 losses); loanword -мен after з in translations (Буллзмен) breaks the strict -бен rule
asi.next_action_hint: instrumental after loanwords is not strict; skip. ablative/genitive nasal guard alone is retrieval-neutral

description: bare possessive -ы/-і not after vowel + қ/к (the possessive would have voiced it): екі, ақын, жалақы keep their root

asi.hypothesis: voicing alternation shows V+қ/к+ы is root-final, removes екі->ек, ақын->ақ collisions
asi.rollback_reason: clean (train 4/2, val 4/0 on ақын queries) but train effect too small: lo99 -0.00016
asi.next_action_hint: candidate to bundle with other voicing-based guards (derivation -лық/-дық/-тық allomorphs) as one 'voicing' change

description: -қан/-кен (voiceless allomorph) on any base; voiced -ған still needs two syllables (deverbal -н of -ға verbs: қорған)

asi.hypothesis: voiceless -қан after a voiceless one-syllable base is unambiguously the participle
asi.rollback_reason: wash: 'Олимпиада қайда өтті' cluster splits half wins half losses; val -0.0011
asi.next_action_hint: verb conflation for 1-syl verbs is consistently a wash on KazQAD (#2,#5,#6,#11). Stop.

description: no accusative -ны/-ні after и (термині, витамині -> термин, витамин)

asi.hypothesis: loanwords in -ин take possessive -і spelt like acc -ні
asi.rollback_reason: wash, 1 win/3 losses; merging термині into термин lowers idf
asi.next_action_hint: target collisions of rare words INTO frequent query stems (like жылқы->жыл) rather than splits

description: harmony: у/и/ю after a consonant is a vowel of unknown class, so a base whose last vowel is one of them takes either class (Париж-де, Мадрид-те, организм-дер, ресурс-тар); no acc -ны or poss -сы after и (термин-і, артис-і)

asi.hypothesis: loanwords whose last vowel is и/у/ю (Париж, Мадрид, организм, ресурс) were blocked by harmony taken from an earlier vowel
asi.lesson: harmony gaps on loanwords are a productive area

description: soft-sign-final loanwords take either harmony class (фестиваль-да/-де, король-дің)

asi.hypothesis: ь-final loans are used with both classes
asi.rollback_reason: train untouched (0/2); val +0.0003
asi.next_action_hint: too rare in KazQAD questions; fold into a later harmony change if one is kept

description: plural allomorph conditions on possessive -лары/-дары/-тары; ль counts as л for -дар (қаңтары, доллары, модельдер)

asi.hypothesis: -дары etc lacked allomorph context, cutting қаңтар, доллар, теледидар
asi.rollback_reason: retrieval-neutral on train (1/1), val -0.0007
asi.next_action_hint: vocabulary-correct but no query impact; skip unless bundled

description: no acc -ны / past -ды after о (loanwords in -он/-од: чемпионы, эпизоды)

asi.hypothesis: final о marks loanword; -он/-од loans outnumber -о loans so -ны/-ды after о is possessive
asi.rollback_reason: questions use accusative of о-final names (Дрогоны, Фортепианоны кім ойлап тапты)
asi.next_action_hint: KazQAD questions are full of 'X-ны кім ...' accusatives; never weaken accusative -ны

description: habitual participle -атын/-етін on a two-syllable consonant base (табылатын->табыл), guarded against loans with non-initial о (чемпионат) and kept before case suffixes

asi.hypothesis: participle reading of C+атын is 8:1 by df over -ат noun+poss+acc
asi.rollback_reason: train +0.0006 with 24/45: merging аталатын/қолданылатын into frequent verb stems dilutes; қабілетін noun losses
asi.next_action_hint: verb conflation is a wash on KazQAD (5th time). Focus on noun-side fixes (loanword harmony etc.)

description: retest on harmony base: genitive -ның / ablative -нан after м (адамның, әлемнің -> адам, әлем)

description: soft л/ль takes either harmony class and stem-final ь is dropped (медаль, медалі, медальдің -> медал; королі -> корол)

description: possessive -сы readings: not after у (вирус-ы), glide у counts as consonant (дауыс-ы, қуыс-ы, туыс-ы), allowed after г/к/қ+ы/і (белгі-сі, үлгі-сі, алғашқы-сы)
